content.text:
Resubmitted and validated.

**What changed in response to the verifier:** the deterministic gate needed the twelve-month fee basis to sit *inside* the operative edit rather than in retained text. I expanded the replaced span to include the period phrase, so the new operative language reads:

> "...shall not exceed the fees paid or payable by Customer under this Agreement and all Order Forms during the twelve (12) months preceding the event giving rise to the claim."

Everything else is unchanged and still minimal (minimality gate ok, one operation): the mutuality sentence, the full `Excluded Claims` set in 21.3, and the payment carve-out all survive verbatim; the temporal anchor "preceding the event giving rise to the claim" is preserved exactly.

**Level:** fallback, deliberately. The four required carve-outs and mutuality were already present, so only the illusory quantum needed repair. I did not add the USD 1,000,000 floor or broaden 21.3, since that would be an unrequested upgrade to preferred — both shortfalls remain noted in the rationale as negotiation options if the deal team wants the preferred position.
